description_en: Calculates and returns the next 5 execute times based on a Cron expression, allowing you to verify that a validation rule is correct before configuring a scheduled data validation task. This is a general-purpose operation that does not require authentication
description_zh: 依据 Cron 表达式计算并返回后续 5 次执行时间，用于配置定时校验前验证规则是否正确；通用接口，无需鉴权
name: GetCronExecTime

parameters.help_en: The Cron expression. Replace spaces with plus signs `+` when passing the expression as a query parameter
parameters.name: cron_rule

data.description_en: The data list returned by the operation. For the structure of each element, see the child field descriptions
data.description_zh: 接口返回的数据列表，元素结构参见下级子字段说明

items.description_en: The business data returned by the operation in string format. The specific content varies by operation
items.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据（字符串形式），具体内容随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues related to this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values: true and false. If false is returned, use errCode and errMessage to troubleshoot
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
